name: WapiKit
title: wapikit.com
shortDescription: WapiKit leverages AI to enhance customer interactions on WhatsApp, automating responses and driving sales without the need for manual input. It's designed for businesses looking to scale their customer engagement and sales operations efficiently. An example use case is a retail company using WapiKit to automatically recommend products and close sales through WhatsApp conversations.
